title: Shared services
subtitle: A repeatable platform interface
body: Power, heat rejection, mounting, computing, telemetry and a complete record of every batch. A common design can be reused across programs; actual hardware reuse depends on the mission and qualification.
boundary: The shared bus does not remove the need for product-specific containment or equipment validation.

title: Specialized cartridges
subtitle: Three families, many recipes
body: Thermal processing, solution growth and particle assembly each use appropriate internals. Materials stay independently contained. Cartridge-specific optics, fluid paths, coatings, actuators and sensors can plug into common services.
boundary: A shared interface does not mean the same chamber can handle every solvent, temperature or biologic.

title: Manufacturing OS
subtitle: The same decision framework
body: Recipes define permitted actions and acceptance measurements. Calibrated measurements estimate state; validated controllers act within limits. Scheduling coordinates compatible jobs, and Earth qualification updates the next campaign.
boundary: Language models support research and tool use. Validated numerical and control systems execute physical decisions.
